title: Message actions
summary: Native long-press context menus expose the actions that apply to a message, without visible overflow buttons. Accessibility and send-state controls retain the existing action sheet.

kind.description: One row of the sheet, in this order.

rowId.description: The message the sheet is open for. Missing while closed.

showsReactions.description: false for messages that take no reactions (message-reactions).

actions.description: Only the actions that apply to this message (see notes).

open.effect: Opens the sheet with a light haptic. Date, notice and handle-change rows have no sheet.

react.effect: message-reactions toggle, then closes the sheet.

moreReactions.effect: Closes the sheet and runs message-reactions openPicker.

choose.effect: Closes the sheet and runs: reply, message-reply startReply; replyInThread, threads openThread (bipe-chat/bipe#667, groups only); edit, message-edit startEdit; copy, puts the text on the clipboard and shows bipe_app_copied; forward, message-forward open (bipe-chat/bipe#664); saveSticker, adds the sticker to the user's pack (sticker-picker notes, bipe-chat/bipe#670) and shows bipe_sticker_saved or bipe_sticker_save_failed; viewStickerPack, opens sticker-pack with the event's stickerPackField; keepAudio, voice-message keep; unkeepAudio, voice-message unkeep; retry, chat-timeline retrySend; delete, message-delete askDelete; report, message-report open.

notes: MZ explicitly requested SF Symbols in iOS context-menu options on 23 October 2026. Native SwiftUI Label(systemImage:) supplies message-option and reaction-picker icons; Android keeps its current icon system. Action availability and permissions do not change.

reply: canReply and the message is sent. edit: canEdit. copy: text messages only. keepAudio: a sent voice message (isVoice) with media available that the caller does not keep (voice-message kept no); its title is bipe_voice_keep. unkeepAudio: a voice message the caller keeps; its title is bipe_voice_unkeep. retry: own message with send state failed. delete: canDelete, or an own message not sent yet. report: messages of other people that are sent.
Undecryptable rows: report only, and the message-undecryptable help when its cause has one. Deleted rows have no sheet.
Not in this sheet (ADR 0141 and plan section 4): threads, pin, copy link to the message, forward, view source. Forward and media save come with #561.
The sheet shows the message on top, so the person sees what they act on. The haptic follows ADR 0134 (registries haptics, selection).

MZ explicitly requested long press only on 23 October 2026: native iOS contextMenu and Android DropdownMenu open from a normal long press, with no visible overflow button (bipe#589). Labelled accessibility actions keep the same commands available to VoiceOver and TalkBack. Do not attach a second long-press recognizer that competes with the native menu. Keep scrolling, swipe-to-reply and media/reply taps.

Every command resolves the current row and checks current permissions again at dispatch. A removed, deleted, non-message or no-longer-authorised target cannot dispatch an old command. Menus belong to the timeline model of one immutable account session. New incoming rows do not change the target.
copy on a message with a running money pause (scam-warning pauseSecondsLeft above 0) is shown disabled with bipe_pause_countdown as its label, and comes back as Copiar at 0 (bipe#594).

saveSticker: a sent m.sticker event. It writes the event's mxc URL into the user's pack (m.image_pack account data) with no upload; an image already there (same mxc URL) is not added again and still shows bipe_sticker_saved. Default chosen (bipe-chat/bipe#670): the row shows on every sent sticker, because the menu does not load the pack. mz can overrule. viewStickerPack: a sent m.sticker event with stickerPackField (registries/stickers.json) naming a room and a state key (ADR 0205).
